meta.title: Guided setup
meta.description: Fill in the required configuration step by step so AI angle extraction, asset generation and file storage all work.

page.title: Guided setup
page.subtitle: Each item below has to be set up before the matching feature works. Steps that already pass are collapsed.

login.title: Sign in first
login.hint: The configuration check needs you to be signed in.

load.failedDesc: We could not read the result — the service may still be starting. Try again in a moment.

banner.more: {{count}} other items are not set up either.

agentUpstream.title: Upstream AI
agentUpstream.broken: AI angle extraction is down: the upstream AI is not set up
agentUpstream.what: Features like "let AI extract angles" forward the request to an upstream AI service. This is that service's address and key.
agentUpstream.impact: Without it, "let AI extract angles" only ever returns Internal server error. The key shipped in the repo is a placeholder, so the upstream always rejects it.
agentUpstream.where: Create an API key in your model provider's console, then paste its messages endpoint and that key here. If you run your own gateway, use its address instead.

aiChatModels.title: Chat model channel
aiChatModels.broken: AI chat and asset generation are down: the model channel is not set up
aiChatModels.what: AI chat, comment replies and AI-generated assets all go through this channel. The model list ships with the repo and rarely needs changing — the key does.
aiChatModels.impact: Without it, every page that uses AI either errors out or spins forever.
aiChatModels.where: Get an API key from the same provider console. Leave the address as it is for the official endpoint, or point it at your own gateway.

assets.title: Object storage
assets.broken: Images and videos cannot be stored: object storage is not set up
assets.what: Avatars, assets and everything the AI generates are stored in object storage.
assets.impact: Without it, uploads fail and assets that were already generated will not open.
assets.where: This one is foundational, so it can only be changed in the server's .env (the ASSETS_ variables), followed by another deploy run.

projectsRoot.title: Project file root
projectsRoot.broken: Project files cannot be read: the project file root is not set up
projectsRoot.what: Every file in a project lives under this directory on the server.
projectsRoot.impact: If the directory is missing or the container cannot write to it, project files will neither open nor save.
projectsRoot.where: Also .env only. Make sure the directory really is mounted into the container and is writable.

notify.title: Notification channel
notify.broken: No notifications will arrive: the notification channel is not set up
notify.what: Sends a push to your phone when a task finishes or an asset is generated.
notify.impact: Nothing else breaks — you just will not be told when something finishes.
notify.where: Your own push address goes in Settings → Notifications. The server-wide fallback channel lives in the server's .env.

unknown.title: {{key}}
unknown.what: This check was added on the server and the web app has no description for it yet.
unknown.impact: While it fails, the matching feature may not work correctly.
unknown.where: It maps to {{path}} in the configuration, which you can find on the configuration page.

baseUrl.label: Upstream endpoint
baseUrl.desc: Point it at the messages endpoint, not just the domain.

apiKey.label: Upstream key
apiKey.desc: The API key your provider issued. It is never shown again after you save it.

defaultModel.label: Default model
defaultModel.desc: Used when no model is specified. Use the model name exactly as your provider documents it.
defaultModel.placeholder: Model name from your provider's docs

apiKey.label: Channel key
apiKey.desc: The API key used for chat and asset generation. It is never shown again after you save it.

baseUrl.label: Channel address
baseUrl.desc: Leave the default for the official endpoint; change it only if you run a gateway.

generic.label: {{path}}
generic.desc: This maps to {{path}} in the configuration.

secret.configured: Already set. Leave it empty to keep it; type a new value to replace it.
secret.placeholderSet: Leave empty to keep the current key

save.hotHint: This one takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
save.restartHint: Saved. This one only takes effect after the service restarts.

error.loadConfig: Could not read the current configuration — check that the service is reachable.
error.protectedKey: This one can only be changed in the server's .env; the runtime override layer rejects it.
error.writeFailed: The configuration file could not be written. Check that the override file is mounted writable.
error.readFailed: The existing override file could not be read — its format may be broken.
error.invalid: The value does not pass configuration validation. Check it against the notes above.
error.unsupportedFormat: The server does not recognise the override file's extension; only yaml, yml and json are supported.

restart.success: The service is restarting. Check again in a few seconds.
restart.failed: The restart did not go through

recheck.failed: Still failing — the reason is below.

manual.title: This one can only be changed on the server
manual.desc: It is foundational, so the runtime override layer will not accept it. Change the .env, run the deploy script again, then come back and press "Check again".

notEditable.title: This one cannot be filled in here
notEditable.desc: Its value is a list, not a single line, so a text box cannot edit it. Change it on the configuration page.

skip.hint: This one is optional — you can skip it and come back later.
skip.done: Skipped. It does not hold up the other steps.

done.title: All set
done.desc: Everything required passes. Head back home and start using it.
